registered: 2026-09-21, after P2 and before any time-domain run of an equivalent
context: context_p2.json of the frozen input set
k_basis: frequency-domain results of P2 only: the smallest K at which the response-feature equivalent stays within 5 percent at the build and the test input, and one smaller K. No time-domain error was known.
models: per scenario: F, the K = 12 equivalent with one chain per hall, and the parameter-feature and the response-feature equivalent at each registered K, fixed membership; at K = 2 both feature sets give one grouping
inputs: the build and the test input of every scenario; same input file, allocation, window and output instants for every model

solver.production: Rodas, KLU, rtol 1e-4, atol 1e-6, hmax 0.01 s, output every 0.0025 s, tol_ic 1e-6 (--tol paper)
solver.strict: rtol 1e-8, atol 1e-10 (--tol main): per scenario F and the response-feature equivalent of the main K, build input; the strict run of F is the P1 screen run of the same model and input
solver.rerun_rule: a reported difference below 0.1 percent is rerun at rtol 1e-6

errors.interval: 1 s to 61 s, the input window
errors.deviation: every model minus its OWN initial value
per_output: rms_abs = RMS of the difference of the deviations
rms_rel = rms_abs / RMS of the deviation of F; not applicable below 1e-6 of the output base
e_max_rel = e_max / largest absolute deviation of F
errors.separate: time-domain errors, band errors and single-frequency gain errors are reported separately and never replace one another

representative_chain: the chain of F with the largest DC-link excursion under the input, and the chain of the equivalent whose group contains the hall of that chain; shown to connect excitation and response, no statement on every internal state
offpeak: offpeak_control.json of P2; the models of its scenario; gain and phase from a fit over the last 20 s; the sinusoid is a controlled test signal, not a task model

figure.case: S2, build input: the scenario with the largest frequency-domain error in P2
figure.zoom: [t* - 0.5 s, t* + 1.5 s] of the window, t* the transition with the largest absolute jump of the site terminal demand; fixed from the input alone, the same for every model

timing.protocol: one process per input, alone on the server, 2 BLAS and Numba threads; every model built once and warmed up once; three timed rounds, model order rotated by one per round; median and range; the timed sink keeps the PCC active power only; build time listed separately
timing.note: at the production setting the step is bounded by the 0.01 s input knots for every model, so a time ratio reflects the cost per step; it is not derived from the state count

never: no K, model, input, window or error definition is changed after a time-domain error has been seen
